Actress Carla Jeffery, Star of Disney's 'Zombies', Dies at 33

Carla Jeffery, the 33-year-old actress known for her role as Bree in Disney's "Zombies" film franchise, died on Tuesday. Her management agency confirmed her death via an Instagram post. Social media users have since shared tributes to the actress.
